title: 🔥 STOP MAKING EXCUSES—YOUR SOUL IS AT RISK! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 STOP MAKING EXCUSES—YOUR SOUL IS AT RISK! 🚨🔥
📖 Luke 14:18 – "But they all alike began to make excuses."

🚨 MANY PEOPLE WANT HEAVEN—BUT FEW WANT TO FOLLOW JESUS! WHY?
Because they have EXCUSES!
❌ "I’ll follow God later!"
❌ "I’m too busy!"
❌ "God understands!"

🔥 BUT THE TRUTH IS—EXCUSES WON’T SAVE YOU ON JUDGMENT DAY!
📖 2 Corinthians 6:2 – "Now is the day of salvation!"
👉 ARE YOU TRULY FOLLOWING JESUS, OR JUST MAKING EXCUSES? THIS MESSAGE MAY BE YOUR FINAL WARNING!

🔥 1. "I’LL FOLLOW GOD LATER!"—BUT WHAT IF THERE IS NO LATER?
📖 James 4:14 – "You do not know what will happen tomorrow. Your life is a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes."

🔥 THE DEVIL’S FAVORITE LIE:
"You have plenty of time to get right with God!"
🚨 BUT YOU AREN’T PROMISED TOMORROW!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A young man planned to follow Jesus "later"—but he never got the chance. He died suddenly in a car accident. He thought he had more time, but hell is full of people who thought the same.
📖 Proverbs 27:1 – "Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring."
👉 ARE YOU PUTTING OFF YOUR SALVATION, THINKING YOU HAVE TIME?

🔥 2. "I’M TOO BUSY!"—BUT NOTHING IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN YOUR SOUL!
📖 Mark 8:36 – "What does it profit a man to gain the whole world and lose his soul?"
🔥 SATAN DOESN’T NEED YOU TO HATE GOD—HE JUST NEEDS YOU DISTRACTED!

❌ Too busy with work? Your job won’t save you!
❌ Too busy with family? Your family can’t save you!
❌ Too busy having fun? Eternity is forever!
🚨 DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A woman was too busy chasing success. She said, "I’ll focus on God when I retire." But she died at 45. She planned for her future on earth but ignored her eternity.
📖 Ecclesiastes 12:1 – "Remember your Creator in the days of your youth."
👉 WHAT IS KEEPING YOU TOO "BUSY" TO FOLLOW JESUS?

🔥 3. "GOD UNDERSTANDS MY HEART!"—YES, AND THAT SHOULD SCARE YOU!
📖 Jeremiah 17:9 – "The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked."

🔥 WHAT PEOPLE SAY:
❌ "God knows my heart, so I don’t have to repent!"
❌ "I love God in my own way, so I don’t need to obey the Bible!"
❌ "God is loving, so He won’t judge me!"
🚨 BUT THE BIBLE SAYS—IF YOU LOVE GOD, YOU WILL OBEY HIM!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man lived in sin but said, "God understands!" He ignored every warning. But on Judgment Day, Jesus won’t say ‘I understand’—He will say ‘DEPART FROM ME!’
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven."
👉 ARE YOU USING "GOD UNDERSTANDS" AS AN EXCUSE FOR DISOBEDIENCE?

🔥 4. "I’M A GOOD PERSON!"—BUT GOOD PEOPLE DON’T GO TO HEAVEN, SAVED PEOPLE DO!
📖 Romans 3:10 – "There is no one righteous, not even one."

🔥 THE LIE:
"I don’t need Jesus—I’m a good person!"
🚨 BUT THE BIBLE SAYS YOUR GOODNESS ISN’T ENOUGH!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man spent his life helping others but never surrendered to Jesus. He thought his "good deeds" would save him. But without Jesus, NO ONE is good enough!
📖 Isaiah 64:6 – "All our righteous acts are like filthy rags."
👉 ARE YOU TRUSTING IN YOUR GOODNESS INSTEAD OF JESUS?

🔥 5. "I GO TO CHURCH!"—BUT CHURCH WON’T SAVE YOU, ONLY JESUS CAN!
📖 John 14:6 – "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."

🔥 WHAT PEOPLE THINK:
❌ "I go to church, so I’m saved!"
❌ "My parents are Christian, so I’m fine!"
❌ "I grew up religious!"
🚨 BUT JESUS DIDN’T DIE FOR A RELIGION—HE DIED TO SAVE YOU!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A churchgoer thought attending church was enough. He never repented, never read the Bible, and never truly followed Jesus. But a church membership won’t get you into heaven!
📖 Matthew 15:8 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me."
👉 ARE YOU RELIGIOUS, OR ARE YOU SAVED?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: NO MORE EXCUSES—IT’S TIME TO FOLLOW JESUS!
📖 Hebrews 3:15 – "Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts."

🔥 EXCUSES WON’T STAND BEFORE GOD!
❌ "I was too busy!" – Your time was a gift from God!
❌ "I thought I had more time!" – You were warned!
❌ "I was a good person!" – Your righteousness wasn’t enough!
❌ "I went to church!" – Salvation is through Jesus, not a building!
🚨 JESUS IS CALLING—BUT THE DOOR WON’T STAY OPEN FOREVER!

🔥 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
You have two choices:
✔️ Repent, surrender, and follow Jesus!
❌ Keep making excuses—and face judgment!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SURRENDER TO JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my excuses! I repent of my sins and choose to follow You completely. No more delays, no more distractions! Be my Lord and Savior! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥
